title: Probing Electrostatic Disorder via g-Tensor Geometry
summary: Low-frequency charge noise induced by fluctuating electrostatic disorder is a major limitation for semiconductor hole spin qubits. Here, we analyze the quasistatic response of a hole spin qubit to individual two-level fluctuators (TLFs). We show that, due to the anisotropy of the g-tensor, the qubit response depends on the geometry of the fluctuator-induced dipolar perturbation.
